description: "What's the effect of [variant]" / "predict consequences of [genomic change]" / "VEP for [chrom:pos]" — Variant Effect Predictor for a specified region + allele. Returns consequences (missense, synonymous, splice, etc.), affected genes, transcript impacts, SIFT/PolyPhen predictions. Use for variant interpretation in clinical or research genomics. THE REGION IS REQUIRED — there is no default. A GRCh37/hg19 position is also a valid GRCh38 position, so an unstated build cannot be detected, only guessed wrong, and a wrong guess returns confident annotations for a DIFFERENT gene rather than an error.

assembly.description: REQUIRED. The genome build your region is in: "GRCh38" (= hg38) or "GRCh37" (= hg19). There is no default on purpose — a genomic position is valid in BOTH builds, so an unstated build cannot be detected, only guessed wrong, and a wrong guess returns confident consequence calls for a different gene instead of an error.

region.description: e.g. "9:22125504-22125504:1" — in the build named by assembly.

name: vep
